purpose: Which instrument now carries each of the fourteen operations the live-operations console was built to drive. The console itself is not in this repository and cannot be rebuilt from it; this declares, from outside the specification, where its work went.
whyThisExists: docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/deployment/live-operations-console/SHA256_MANIFEST.json declares six files. Four are present and every digest matches. Two are absent: README.md and index.html — and index.html IS the console. ACTIVATION_AND_VALIDATION.md line 2 says "Open index.html"; there is no index.html anywhere in the tree and no ZIP to extract one from. Until 2026-09-15 docs/deployment/OUTSTANDING_SOURCES.json explained the specification as "a specification of what exists", which was false: the thing it specifies does not exist here.
whatCarriedByMeans: NOT closed. Every operation below is still outstanding work in the tenant. `carriedBy` names the register entry that counts it and the runbook section that carries its steps, so the operation is tracked somewhere a command can see. The console was a fifth view of a workstream three instruments already describe; losing the view lost no obligation. Counting these fourteen again alongside the readiness items would count the same work twice, which is why the specification stays uncounted in OUTSTANDING_SOURCES.json. Since 2026-10-02 each carriedBy names a readiness-register item; 'was' keeps the P- or F- entry it replaced.

replacedInPlace.why: The manifest's README.md shipped in the delivered package and does not survive. A NEW README.md was written here on 2026-09-16 to tell a reader what happened. It stands in the same place under the same name and is not the same document — its bytes will never match the digest the manifest records, and that mismatch is the truth rather than a fault. The manifest is a record of what was delivered and is not edited to agree with today.

consoleIsAbsent.why: index.html embedded its own operational model — ACTIVATION_AND_VALIDATION.md line 2: "The console can also run when only index.html is copied because the operational model is embedded." EMBEDDED_DATA_MODEL.json and IMPLEMENTATION_PARAMETER_REGISTER.md describe what it held and what it rendered; neither is the renderer. Rebuilding would mean writing a new console to a specification of an old one, and reproducing a dashboard whose figures were true on its own date.
consoleIsAbsent.decision: Superseded rather than rebuilt, 2026-09-15. The four remaining files are a record: read them, never edit them.
